title: Forza Horizon 6
summary: DLSS Ray Reconstruction for Forza Horizon 6 via Streamline.
notes: Replaces the game's DLSS SR with DLSS Ray Reconstruction, feeding RR the real G-buffer guides and the raw RT resolve signal (the game's neighbourhood denoisers are bypassed).
Requires DirectX 12, an NVIDIA RTX GPU, and ReShade with full add-on support.
